description: Returns one land parcel of the public registry of Georgia by its cadastral code (01.15.05.066.020): the address, the area, the land type, the ownership type, the owners, the registry documents with links to their PDFs, and the centre point. Without a code, find one with parcels_list_nearby_parcels. NAPR publishes every text in Georgian only. Buildings and apartments are not covered. Data from NAPR.

code.description: The cadastral code: 4 or 5 groups of digits with dots, as 01.15.05.066.020.

name: parcels_get_parcel

address.description: The address, in Georgian, as NAPR publishes it.

area_unit.description: m2, or the unit of NAPR.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the parcel, RFC 3339.

centre.description: The centre point of the parcel.

documents.description: The registry documents, by kind, newest first.

date.description: The date of the document, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty when NAPR gives none.

name.description: The name of the code, in Georgian. For other, the text of NAPR.
The name of the code, in Georgian. For other, the text of NAPR.

map_url.description: The page of the parcel on the NAPR map.

owners.description: The owners, as NAPR names them. Empty when NAPR names none.

name.description: The name of the code, in Georgian. For other, the text of NAPR.

source.description: The source of the data: NAPR.

stale.description: True when NAPR did not answer and the server returns a parcel it read before.

title: Get a land parcel of Georgia
